AAJ - PILOT-TO-CONTRACT PLAN: Example Unified School District (fictional) (School or district)
RE-PLAN THE DATES - The results arrive after the district can commit next year's money. Fix the timeline before anything else.
TIMELINE
2027-01-11  Kickoff
2027-02-15  Mid-point review
2027-03-15  Buyer budget decision
2027-03-22  Pilot ends
2027-03-29  Results readout
2027-04-12  Buyer decision
2027-05-06  Last decision date to sign by fiscal year start
2027-06-07  Contract signature target
2027-07-01  Fiscal year starts
Latest kickoff that lands the decision by 2027-03-15: 2026-12-14  (slack: -28 days)
CRITERIA                                   measurable baselined owned agreed
Weekly active classrooms                  yes       yes       yes       yes
Reading screener: students at benchmark   yes       NO        yes       NO
Teacher feedback                          NO        NO        NO        NO
End-of-year state test scores             yes       yes       yes       NO
EVIDENCE NEEDED: Outcome comparison (before and after, or against a comparison group)
THE THREE FIXES THAT MATTER MOST
1. Start by 2026-12-14 or shorten the pilot, so the readout lands by 2027-03-01.
2. Get the person who owns the budget to agree the criteria and attend the readout.
3. Put the criteria in a one-page pilot plan and get the champion and the economic buyer to sign it before kickoff.
ALL FINDINGS
!  [timeline] The results readout (2027-03-29) lands after the budget decision (2027-03-15). The district would be deciding next year's money before it sees the results.
!  [deal] No economic buyer involved. The champion can run the pilot, but the superintendent, business office or board decides whether it becomes a contract.
!  [criteria] Not agreed in writing: "Reading screener: students at benchmark", "Teacher feedback", "End-of-year state test scores". Unwritten criteria can be redefined after the results come in.
!  [criteria] Not measurable: "Teacher feedback". A target needs a number and a stated way of counting it.
!  [criteria] Cannot move within 10 weeks on your own estimate: "Reading screener: students at benchmark".
!  [criteria] No baseline: "Reading screener: students at benchmark", "Teacher feedback". The buyer wants an outcome comparison, and there is nothing to compare against.
-  [deal] Conversion terms do not yet cover the contract start date or what happens if the criteria are met.
-  [criteria] 4 criteria. This engine flags more than 3: with more, someone can always point at the one that missed.
-  [criteria] No data owner: "Teacher feedback". Someone has to pull the number, and the buyer trusts its own data more than yours.
-  [criteria] May only change after the pilot ends: "End-of-year state test scores". Annual and end-of-year measures report after a short pilot is over.
NOTE  Student data: ask what the district's privacy and security review needs before students use the product, start it before kickoff, and check your obligations with counsel.
